Earnings both from operating efficiency and financial management is a key driver of returns to shareholders.
Free cash flow is a key driver of shareholder returns and captures items not included in GAAP net income
Increases in market share is a driver of revenue and income across our portfolios and regions.
Both Quality and Inclusion, Diversity, and Equity (ID&E) are components of our scorecard that directly impact payouts of our annual incentive plan.
Complimenting our ID&E category was Quality emphasizing both compliance and quality.

Our Performance Share Unit plan is a 3-year incentive plan that is based on long-term measures of company performance

If the three-year ROIC target is not achieved the overall performance score is reduced by 30%.
